description: This file defines the DefaultMenuLinkTreeManipulators class in Drupal, providing methods for manipulating menu link trees, including access checks, node access optimization, sorting, and flattening.

classes.name: DefaultMenuLinkTreeManipulators
classes.description: Provides methods for manipulating Drupal menu link trees, including access checks, node access optimization, sorting, and flattening.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Performs access checks on a menu link tree, replacing inaccessible links with placeholders and removing subtrees as needed.

methods.name: checkNodeAccess
methods.description: Optimized access checking for nodes within a menu link tree.

methods.name: collectNodeLinks
methods.description: Recursively collects node links in the menu tree for access checking.

methods.name: menuLinkCheckAccess
methods.description: Checks access for a single menu link instance based on its URL.

methods.name: generateIndexAndSort
methods.description: Creates a unique index for menu links and sorts the tree accordingly.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Flattens a hierarchical menu link tree into a single-level array.
